title: DoorsIndividually
description: This object is used to represent a door individually.

traceId.description: A unique identifier to be able to trace this message. Also used to detect duplicate messages received.

eventTimestamp.description: As specified in the [ADT documentation.](https://adt.transhub.io). Reflects the current UTC time.

messageNumber.description: [Optional] - Sequence number that should generated on the vehicle and increased by one for each new message. Used to validate consistency in the data stream.

doorRef.description: Has to be the same reference as is used in the topic sensors/apc_sensors.

isOpen.description: True if the door is open.
